'''Niklas Cories''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who worked as an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]. He often used [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] to eliminate his targets.<ref name="TCSWE" />

==Biography==
A noted [[Music/Legends|musician]] and singer, Cories was son of a wealthy entrepreneur in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. He had a grudge against the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], who had put out numerous contracts on his head.<ref name="TCSWE" />

Under the alias of '''Aphus Polix''', Cories gained a job helping out the band [[Distraction]] and he kept his work as an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] secret from them. He traveled with them while they toured the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], and he had a brief relationship with [[Aquella Firth]], a fan of the band. When she dumped him, he wanted revenge, so arranged for her to gain tickets for a concert the band were playing aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Sleemo Poya Jeedai]]'', where he planned to attack her. He kidnapped [[Ushka Et]], a member of the band, an then masqueraded as her during the concert, where he attempted to throw a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] into the crowd.
